_comment: Short-form group news. Shown on the home page (latest N) and in the News tab of the Blog page. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) and sorted newest-first automatically.

items.title: Atharva and Je-Wei win the Qualcomm Innovation Fellowship 2026
items.text: Atharva Raut and Je-Wei Chuang received the Qualcomm Innovation Fellowship 2026 for their proposal on thermal digital twins for advanced chip designs.

items.title: Sanjay Seshan awarded NSF GRFP
items.text: PhD student Sanjay Seshan was selected as one of 2,500 National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program winners.

items.title: Srimani receives NSF CAREER Award
items.text: Professor Tathagata Srimani received an NSF Faculty Early Career Development Award, a prestigious five-year grant supporting junior faculty research and education.

items.title: Eric Dubberstein selected as DAC 2026 Young Fellow
items.text: PhD student Eric Dubberstein earned Young Fellow status for the 63rd Design Automation Conference in Long Beach, California.

items.title: PowerWeave accepted at ISCA 2026
items.text: The PowerWeave collaboration was accepted to ISCA 2026, focusing on GPU power efficiency improvements through fine-grained voltage and frequency scaling.

items.title: Atharva Raut receives Wei Shen and Xuehong Zhang Presidential Fellowship
items.text: Atharva Raut was awarded this prestigious fellowship for the 2025–2026 academic year.

items.title: Technical session at IEDM: foundry monolithic 3D
items.text: A technical session addressed monolithic 3D integration combining memory, logic, and emerging materials.

items.title: Paper accepted to DATE 2026 on 3D IC thermal solutions
items.text: "3D IC Thermal Management with BEOL Wafer-Scale Sputtered Vertical h-BN" was accepted to the DATE 2026 conference.

items.title: Tathagata Srimani elevated to IEEE Senior Member
items.text: Professor Srimani achieved this distinction, which recognizes exceptional accomplishments in electrical and computer engineering.

items.title: Sanjay Seshan joins NEXUS as a PhD student
items.text: Sanjay Seshan joined the group as a PhD student, bringing a background in computer architecture from MIT.

items.title: Tong starts internship at Qualcomm
items.text: PhD student Tong Wu began a Qualcomm Fellowship internship focused on AI inference accelerator architecture.

items.title: Probabilistic bits using perimeter-gated single photon avalanche diodes
items.text: Published in IEEE Electron Device Letters, vol. 46, no. 8, pp. 1417–1420.

items.title: Scalable connectivity for Ising machines: dense to sparse
items.text: Published in Physical Review Applied, vol. 24, 014005.

items.title: Eric starts internship at AMD
items.text: Eric Dubberstein joined Advanced Micro Devices as an L3 Cache RTL Design Intern.

items.title: Overcoming ambient drift and NBTI in foundry carbon nanotube transistors
items.text: Published in ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces.

items.title: Atharva Raut receives Tan Endowed Graduate Fellowship
items.text: Atharva Raut was awarded the Tan Endowed Graduate Fellowship for 2024–2025.

items.title: Eric Dubberstein receives NSF Graduate Research Fellowship
items.text: Eric Dubberstein was awarded an NSF Graduate Research Fellowship.

items.title: Srimani wins Best Paper at VLSI
items.text: The team won the Best Student Paper Award at the 2023 IEEE Symposium on VLSI for research on monolithic 3D integration.
